blocks.html:
This method creates an RBAC role. It sends a request to the Create RBAC Role
API route.

children.name: parent_id
children.description: The ID of the parent role, if any.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the role.

children.name: policy_ids
children.description:
The IDs of the policies to attach to the role on creation. The actor
must hold every policy in the list; omit or
leave empty to create a role without any policies.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the created role.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: policies
children.description: Comma-separated relations to include in the response. Can include `policies`.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: parent_id
children.description: The ID of the parent role, if any.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the role.

children.name: policies
children.description: The policies associated with the role.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the role was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the role was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the role was deleted.
